title: Driveway minimum width 3 m
text: Driveways must be: i. a minimum 3m wide; ii. a maximum 6m wide at the street boundary; iii. in areas coded R35 and below, a maximum aggregate width no greater than 9m for any one property; iv. set back 6m to a street corner (refer Figure 3.7b); v. aligned at right angles to the road carriageway; and vi. adequately trafficable and drained.

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: No driveway setback from the side lot boundary in the draft (Part B 0.5 m, Part C 0.3 m deleted; not in the table of changes).
